"""Typed payload models for compiled fuzz frames.

The models keep the project frame names and spelling from the protocol table
(`headers`/`data`/`datagram`/`sleep`, `data_to_transfered`, `End_Stream`,
`Time_to_Stop`) but carry already compiled compressed byte payloads, so the
frame adapter and the client replay consume the same typed objects.
"""
from typing import Dict, List, Literal, Optional, Tuple, Union

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from modules.byte_program import MAX, Seq


class CompiledPayload(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True, extra='forbid')


class H3HeaderFrame(CompiledPayload):
    Type: Literal["headers"] = Field("headers", description="Fixed value, 'headers'")
    headers_kv: Optional[Dict[str, Seq]] = Field(
        None, description="Optional header mapping in JSON member order")
    data_to_transfered: Optional[List[Tuple[Seq, Seq]]] = Field(
        None, description="Compiled header pairs preserving duplicates")
    End_Stream: bool = Field(False, description="Whether this frame closes the request send side")


class H3DataFrame(CompiledPayload):
    Type: Literal["data", "datagram"] = Field("data", description="usually 'data'")
    data_to_transfered: Seq = Field(..., description="Compiled opaque payload bytes")
    End_Stream: bool = Field(True, description="Ignored for datagrams")


class H3SleepFrame(CompiledPayload):
    Type: Literal["sleep"] = "sleep"
    Time_to_Stop: int = Field(0, ge=0, le=MAX, description="Virtual pause in milliseconds")


Frame = Union[H3HeaderFrame, H3DataFrame, H3SleepFrame]


class FuzzingPayload(CompiledPayload):
    test_cases: Dict[str, List[Frame]] = Field(
        ..., description="A collection of test cases keyed by case name")


def compile_cases(cases, context):
    """Compile validated case frames into the typed payload model."""
    data = {}
    for index, case in enumerate(cases):
        frames = []
        for position, frame in enumerate(case['frames']):
            kind = frame['Type']
            base = 'case/%d/frame/%d' % (index, position)
            if kind == 'headers':
                if 'headers_kv' in frame:
                    raw = list(frame['headers_kv'].items())
                else:
                    raw = frame['data_to_transfered']
                pairs = []
                for slot, (name, value) in enumerate(raw):
                    pairs.append((
                        context.template(name, '%s/h/%d/n' % (base, slot)),
                        context.template(value, '%s/h/%d/v' % (base, slot))))
                frames.append(H3HeaderFrame.model_construct(
                    Type='headers',
                    headers_kv=dict(pairs) if 'headers_kv' in frame else None,
                    data_to_transfered=pairs,
                    End_Stream=bool(frame.get('End_Stream', False))))
            elif kind in ('data', 'datagram'):
                frames.append(H3DataFrame.model_construct(
                    Type=kind,
                    data_to_transfered=context.template(
                        frame['data_to_transfered'], '%s/data' % base),
                    End_Stream=bool(frame.get('End_Stream', True))))
            elif kind == 'sleep':
                frames.append(H3SleepFrame.model_construct(
                    Type='sleep', Time_to_Stop=frame['Time_to_Stop']))
            else:
                raise ValueError('frame type')
        data[case['name']] = frames
    return FuzzingPayload.model_construct(test_cases=data)
